source_conversation.content: My iPhone is missing and I think I left it on the train. I have my iPad with me. How do I mark my iPhone as lost in Find My?

sections.text: On iPhone: Use the Find My app on another device or a Family Sharing group member's device. 1. In the Find My app, go to the Devices tab. 2. Scroll down and select your missing iPhone or iPad. 3. Tap the More button. 4. Scroll down to 'Lost [Device]', then turn on 'Lost Mode'. 5. Follow the onscreen steps if you want to display your contact information on your missing device. 6. Tap 'Activate'.

On iPhone: If the device is off or offline, it only appears online and in Lost Mode if the device has been turned on and is connected to Wi-Fi or cellular. If Stolen Device Protection is on for iPhone, Face ID or Touch ID is required to turn off Lost Mode, even if someone knows your passcode. If Find My wasn't on before the loss, you can't mark the device as lost or remotely erase it.

On Android: 1. Open the Find Hub app on another Android phone or tablet, or use Find Hub in a browser. 2. Sign in, then select the lost device. 3. Select 'Play sound'. It rings the device at full volume for 5 minutes, even on silent or vibrate.

On Android: 1. Open your device's Settings app. 2. Tap Accessibility, then Magnification. 3. Turn on Magnification shortcut. 4. Optionally, tap Magnification shortcut to choose a trigger. Accessibility button: uses the Accessibility icon at the bottom of the screen. The button's position can vary with your navigation setup. Hold volume keys: press and hold both volume keys. Triple-tap screen: quickly tap the screen 3 times and hold the gesture. This shortcut may slow down your device.
